description: State name: Haryana, Punjab, or Uttar Pradesh.
State-level monthly fire indicator derived from MODIS fire-mask pixels; not a count of unique incidents.
Monthly state-level Normalized Difference Vegetation Index.
Indicates whether an NDVI observation is available (1 = observed, 0 = unavailable).
Difference between the observed HCHO value and its state-level reference mean.
Derived HCHO hotspot label (1 = hotspot, 0 = non-hotspot); exploratory label, not verified crop damage.
